children: Overview
UK oil and gas producer's H1 2026 revenue totaled $91.0 mln, net loss was $1.5 mln
Adjusted EBITDAX for H1 2026 reached $41.9 mln
Company strengthened financial position with $125 mln debt facility and $40 mln equity raise
Outlook
Company expects Etu acquisition to complete in Q3 2026, increasing interests in Blocks 3/05 and 3/05A
Afentra anticipates two additional crude liftings of ~450,000 bbls each in remainder of 2026
Company has hedged 49% of 2026 remaining forecast sales and 24% for 2027
Result Drivers
DRILLING CAMPAIGN - First drilling campaign in Block 3/05 in over a decade contributed to operational progress, per CEO Paul McDade
PACASSA SW DISCOVERY - Successful oil discovery at Pacassa SW supported portfolio growth, per CEO Paul McDade
PRODUCTION DOWNTIME - Output temporarily impacted by gas compression upgrades and drilling unit positioning, operations restored post-period

The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Afentra PLC is GBp125.00, about 52.6% above its September 14 closing price of GBp81.90
The stock recently traded at 3 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 3 three months ago
